turns.text: hi! need two small design things pls. first a printable label + sticker set for my planner, i do a weekly spread w washi tape every sunday night so the stickers need to fit that layout

Happy to help! To make them fit your washi-tape spread, I need a few details:

- How wide is the washi tape you use (roughly)?
- What labels do you want (e.g. class, work, to-do)?
- Any colors you want to stick to?

If you have a color system, send it and I'll match it.

washi is about 15mm wide. labels: class, work, study, errands, food drive. i color code: pink muscles, blue bones, green nerves, yellow for stuff thats on the practical. but for the stickers just use those 4 colors pls, cheerful

Here's the sticker sheet:

[Image: A printable A4 sheet of small planner stickers. Row 1: five rounded 15mm-tall label strips that line up with a washi tape band, reading CLASS (blue), WORK (pink), STUDY (green), ERRANDS (yellow), FOOD DRIVE (green) in a clean rounded font. Row 2: matching half-width flags in the same four colors with tiny checkbox squares. Row 3: small round dots in pink, blue, green and yellow for marking days. Thin dashed cut lines around each sticker.]

The strips are the same height as your tape, so they sit flush or overlap on top of it. Want any changed?

perfect thank u. ok second one, flyer for jun's lumpia. he sells them at the heron & grind counter saturdays. i'll pull the prices and nutrition from jun's sheet, i built it for him so i should double check the numbers lol

Nice, that's a handy thing to have built. Send me the details from the sheet when you're ready: price per roll or per pack, flavors, and any nutrition numbers you want listed. A few other things:

- The business name, if you want it on the flyer
- Saturday hours for the counter
- Any Instagram handle or contact info

Until then I'll use placeholders.

business name is lola's roll. saturdays 6:30-1 at the counter. price is $2 a roll or 6 for $11. nutrition per roll is 120 cal, 6g fat, 210mg sodium. ok wait let me recheck.. yeah those match. no handle yet, leave it off

Here's the flyer:

[Image: A bright, cheerful flyer on a warm yellow background with a hand-drawn lumpia illustration. Large header in red and green: "LOLA'S ROLL". Subhead: "Fresh lumpia, every Saturday!" A banner reads "At the Heron & Grind counter, 6:30 a.m. - 1 p.m." Price badges: "$2 a roll" and "6 for $11". A small footer line: "Per roll: 120 cal | 6g fat | 210mg sodium". Little confetti dots and a steaming-roll doodle in the corners.]

Because you've double-checked the numbers against the sheet, they're ready to print. I can make a half-page version or a counter-sized sign if you like.
half page version would be great, thank u!! ok im gonna eat now

[Image: A half-page version of the flyer, same yellow background and red and green "LOLA'S ROLL" header, with the Saturday counter hours, the $2 and 6-for-$11 prices, and the nutrition line, laid out compactly for printing two per sheet.]

Enjoy your meal! ☕
